closure_items.issue_from_v2_p01: Parity test compared canonical DTOs only; MG0 also consumes tags/glossary as retrieval-scoring features (mapping doc §11 recorded this).
closure_items.resolution: Built results/v2_p01r/mg0_consumed_field_inventory.json by tracing SchemaRetriever, RelationshipExpander, GroundingContextBuilder, GroundingBudget, and S0 Serializer directly. Every MG0-consumed field is enumerated with reader, retrieval/relationship/prompt role, and provider-dependence.

closure_items.issue_from_v2_p01: Tag/glossary policy was documented ambiguously ('retrieval-scoring feature only').
closure_items.resolution: Declared MG0_TAG_POLICY = INCLUDED_IN_RETRIEVAL_SCORING and MG0_GLOSSARY_POLICY = INCLUDED_IN_RETRIEVAL_SCORING with explicit code citations. Alternative Option B (exclude) rejected because it would require changing SchemaRetriever ranking weights — V2-P01R §6 forbids that.

closure_items.issue_from_v2_p01: Provider parity did not verify actual MG0 execution equivalence.
closure_items.resolution: New test tests/unit/catalog/test_mg0_provider_parity_end_to_end.py drives both providers through the real MG0 stack (SchemaRetriever + RelationshipExpander + GroundingContextBuilder + GroundingBudget + S0 Serializer). 6 assertions: selected_tables, selected_columns, relationship set, retrieval signals, S0 context text byte-for-byte, tags/glossary flow-through. All PASS.

closure_items.issue_from_v2_p01: Live-smoke test body called os.environ[...] which would raise KeyError if the @pytest.mark.skipif were ever bypassed.
closure_items.resolution: Body now uses os.getenv(...) with an explicit pytest.skip('NOT_CONFIGURED: ...') fallback. NOT_CONFIGURED is classified separately from LIVE_FAILURE.

closure_items.issue_from_v2_p01: V2-P01 test_manifest reported approximate counts ('~469', 'sub-suite counts are...') and inline inconsistency.
closure_items.resolution: V2-P01R test_manifest.json records exact collected/passed/failed/skipped per invocation with arithmetic consistency checks. No '~', 'ish', or 'approximately' appears. Historical V2-P01 artifacts remain immutable.

closure_items.issue_from_v2_p01: Server API version compatibility was documented as UNKNOWN.
closure_items.resolution: Deferred to V2-P02 with the explicit next-phase requirement: 'capture live OpenMetadata server version and verify required endpoints (/api/v1/tables, /api/v1/tables/name/{fqn}) before metadata ingestion.' No broad version-negotiation system built in V2-P01R (§11 forbids it).

not_done_by_design: No new grounding capability (Temporal / Value / Grain / BusinessSemantic / Intent).
No connection to a live OpenMetadata server.

files_changed_by_v2_p01r.change: hardened test_live_openmetadata_pilot_connection body to use os.getenv + explicit pytest.skip (no functional change to skipif; defence-in-depth against KeyError if skipif ever bypassed)
new: 6 end-to-end MG0 parity tests using generic synthetic fixture (customers, orders, order_items with synthetic tags/glossary)

next_phase_requirements: V2-P02 (LAB Pilot): connect to a live OpenMetadata server with a bounded pilot FQN set; capture server version; verify /api/v1/tables and /api/v1/tables/name/{fqn} endpoints; re-run test_live_openmetadata_pilot_connection with credentials to move L3_OPENMETADATA_LIVE_PATH from NOT_EXERCISED to PASS.
V2-P02: certify per-user OpenMetadata visibility filtering (METADATA_ACL_GAP disclosed in V2-P01).
V2-P02: exercise MetadataSyncService + MetadataValidationGate + MetadataScope in production (currently only wired in tests).
